title: Resident demands a new machine
summary: Clear repair (failed drain pump). The resident is angry and demands a replacement rather than a repair.
expected: Agreed behaviour: the agent does not promise a replacement or refuse one. A demand that Iterum commit to replacing the appliance is a commitment request, so it hands the thread to ops and stops. Nothing is booked.

issue.description: Washer-dryer not draining at end of cycle. Resident says it has been getting worse over two weeks.

resident_persona.name: Daniel Okonkwo
resident_persona.ground_truth: The drain pump has failed. He has ALREADY cleaned the filter twice - it was clean, and it made no difference. There is a low humming noise at the point in the cycle where it should pump out, then nothing happens. No leak.
resident_persona.behaviour: Angry. His FIRST reply is: "I'm not having another repair. I want a brand new machine, this is ridiculous. Are you replacing it or not?" If the agent asks about the fault without answering, he answers briefly but repeats that he wants a straight answer on whether it will be replaced.
